checks: App.tsx has no import from retired data.ts.
App.tsx has no raw save short-field interpretation.
App.tsx has no direct IndexedDB/localStorage API calls.
App.tsx has no img tags, spriteUrl calls, memberReady function, READY overclaim, or Exact build package wording.
No runtime source contains the old /images/pokemon/{id}.png battle-sheet path or the moving pokerogue-assets/beta URL.
data.ts is an empty retirement stub; canonical reference/strategy sources live under reference/, user-data/, and domain/.
Starter ownership derives from caughtAttr != 0 rather than caughtCount.
Packed large attributes are preserved through bigint/string-safe normalization.
Schema-v2 domain facade refuses legacy snapshots.
Account imports use generic snapshot validation; optional private regression values are never bundled.
Canonical 5850 Cheese roster is Eternatus, Drifloon, Scatterbug, Skitty, Burmy, Nincada.
Static architecture audit checks 5850 total cost 12.75 and Luck 13.
All exact-roster team members resolve to canonical starter references.
Fusion Lab reads fusions.v1.json and labels exact inheritance as version-sensitive.
PokemonSprite is the only visible Pokémon artwork path.
Asset resolver uses pinned pokerogue-assets revision 056a1f408f26a3be4fef243f7462cb43608c7928.
Pass 3 audit established 572/572 normal starter icons, 572/572 T1 icons, and paired T2/T3 support for 406 starter roots.
PWA service worker caches pinned icon atlases separately from account IndexedDB.
IndexedDB DB v2 and state schema v2 are explicit.
Legacy state is preserved and marked legacy rather than reinterpreted.
Versioned backups validate backup/state/reference versions and legacy raw backups remain compatibility-supported.
Account reset removes account state while preserving Cache Storage artwork.
Mobile bottom content padding exceeds fixed navigation height and includes safe-area inset.
Import label is visible on mobile.
Readiness wording separates starter availability, shiny targets, and in-run requirements.
Source-backed build notes avoid claiming unsupported exact-build certainty.

knownLimitations: One fresh .prsv import is intentionally required after legacy migration to establish the canonical schema-v2 baseline.
iOS may still present Photo Library/Camera/Choose File for an unrestricted file input; the UI instructs the user to choose Choose File so uncommon .prsv files remain selectable.
Exact per-starter selected form/gender is not yet decoded for display; PokemonSprite uses the canonical default starter form unless a strategy explicitly supplies a form.
The first successful asset-cache warmup requires network access.
AppDeploy produced compiled deployment QA screenshots and zero frontend/network errors, but no separate E2E QA run-group was available for transcript inspection.
finalRule: Future UI pages consume the domain/storage facade and PokemonSprite; they do not interpret raw saves, construct Pokémon asset URLs, or introduce duplicate team/fusion/reference constants.
